title: FLF Fuel Filter Mounting Bracket (12 ORB)
description: FLF's Fuel Filter Mounting Bracket is perfect for mounting the FLF High Flow Fuel Filter to your vehicle. This CAD-designed piece is 3D-printed from an extremely durable and temperature-resistant polymer with brass thread inserts for long service life, and features M6 flanged bolts for even clamping force and convenient installation.
